summary: Verified MaskedLines descender-clipping CSS fix (pb-[0.35em] -mb-[0.22em]) across all 6 hero pages on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Descenders (p, y, g) render fully; no overlap with lines below.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MaskedLines fix verified. Confirmed on /prayer (Let us pray with you. — p and y fully visible), /, /contact, /volunteer, /donate, /mentorship on both desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. Computed styles verified: padding-bottom=25.2px, margin-bottom=-15.84px on desktop (0.35em/0.22em of 72px), and 16.8px/-10.56px on mobile (0.35em/0.22em of 48px). No visual regression — hero paragraph text sits comfortably below headings without overlap.
rca of the issue: Original bug: MaskedLines wrapped each line in `block overflow-hidden` for slide-up reveal animation, but overflow-hidden clipped letter descenders (p, y, g) at the line's baseline-derived box. Fix: added pb-[0.35em] to expand the clip region below the baseline, and -mb-[0.22em] to visually preserve tight line spacing. Confirmed working.
